notes.title: Turret Girl: A Romantic Visual Novel with Match3 Puzzles
notes.notes: If you are looking for a game that combines romance, action, and puzzles, you might want to check out Turret Girl on Steam. This is a game that tells the story of a woman who has a turret implanted on her back to fight off monsters in a post-apocalyptic world. Along the way, she meets other survivors who might become her friends or lovers.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.5
notes.notes:
Hello Turret Girl players!

We hope you're enjoying the game. Today we're releasing a small update that adds some new features and fixes some bugs.

The first addition is automatic saving. Now, if you exit the game during a session, when you return, the game will pick up where you left off. This should make the experience more convenient for you.

We also fixed a bug that caused the screen to freeze if the player ran out of time in the puzzle. Now, instead, a game over screen will appear and offer the option to restart the puzzle.

Finally, we added a reset button that allows the player to erase the save and start from scratch. This can be useful for those who want to experience the game again from the beginning.

We'd like to thank our community for their feedback and suggestions. In particular, we'd like to thank Hanako for their comment that helped us identify and fix these bugs. The community's contribution is key to the success of our game, so thank you all very much.

We hope you continue to enjoy Turret Girl and keep an eye out for more updates in the future.

Until next time!

notes.title: Achievement
notes.notes:
Today we are excited to announce the addition of a new achievement to Turret Girl, our narrative game. The basic premise of the game is to be short and encourage the player to finish it. 

The new achievement is called “The Finisher” and is awarded to players who complete the game in under two hours. We believe this achievement will motivate players to complete the game in a timely manner and experience the full story. 

We have also made some improvements to the game’s UI to make it easier for players to navigate and find their way around the game. We hope these changes will make the game more enjoyable for all players. 

We are excited to see how players respond to the new achievement and the changes we have made. We believe that this will make Turret Girl an even more enjoyable experience for all players.

notes.title: Turret Girl: A Post-Apocalyptic Match3 Game
notes.notes:
Turret Girl: a post-apocalyptic Match3 game is coming soon to Steam! With an epic story, awesome action, and plenty of hentai scenes, this game is sure to get your heart racing! Romance your way to victory in this one-of-a-kind visual novel!

We’re excited to announce that Turret Girl, a post-apocalyptic Match3 game, is coming soon to Steam!

In Turret Girl, you take on the role of a young woman who must survive in a world that has been devastated by a Monster Invasion. With only a handful of survivors remaining, you must do whatever it takes to stay alive.

The gameplay in Turret Girl is a mix of Match3 and visual novel elements. You’ll need to match 3 or more symbols in order to progress through the story. As you progress, you’ll unlock new scenes and hentai scenes.

Turret Girl is a unique and exciting game that we can’t wait to share with you. Keep an eye out for it on Steam!
